title: USAspending Federal Contracts & Re-Compete Radar Input

recipientNames.title: Incumbent / Recipient Names
recipientNames.description: Optional list of contractor or recipient company names to filter (e.g. ['LOCKHEED MARTIN']).

awardingAgency.title: Awarding Top-Tier Agency
awardingAgency.description: Optional US federal awarding agency name (e.g. 'Department of Defense', 'General Services Administration').

placeOfPerformanceState.title: Place of Performance State (2-letter US Code)

awardType.title: Award Type
awardType.description: Filter by prime federal contracts (A/B/C/D), grants (02-05), or both.

startDateFrom.title: Start Date From (YYYY-MM-DD)
startDateFrom.description: Earliest award period date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

endDateTo.title: End Date To (YYYY-MM-DD)
endDateTo.description: Latest award period date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

expiringWithinDays.title: Re-Compete Radar: Expiring Within Days
expiringWithinDays.description: Optional filter returning only active contracts expiring within the next N days (1-1095), sorted by soonest expiration.

maxRecords.title: Max Records
maxRecords.description: Maximum number of federal awards to return (1-200).

outputMode.title: Output Mode
outputMode.description: Choose detailed dataset rows or a compact MCP Re-Compete summary.
